name: Henadad
overview: Henadad is identified in Scripture as a Levite, with his sons and descendants actively involved in the service and rebuilding of the house of God. The passages in Ezra and Nehemiah highlight the commitment of Henadad's lineage, including individuals like Bavai and Binnui, who took leadership roles in repairing the walls of Jerusalem. This demonstrates the faithful participation of Henadad’s family in the restoration and worship life of Israel, emphasizing their dedication to God's work during a critical period of renewal.
